terms: What Pacey is
Pacey helps you plan and pace drinking during one night out. You set a plan, log drinks and water, and Pacey shows your pace and gentle reminders. It is not a programme to stop drinking.
Who can use it
You must be of legal drinking age where you live to use Pacey. If you are not, please don't use the app.
Not medical advice

Pacey is not medical advice. Drink sizes, alcohol amounts and the blood alcohol figure are rough estimates from the numbers you enter. Pacey can't measure your blood alcohol, and your real level can be much higher.
Never drive after drinking
Never use Pacey to decide whether you can drive, cycle, swim, operate machinery or do anything else that needs you to be sober. If you have been drinking, get a ride home.
Your choices
You decide what and how much you drink, and you are responsible for following the law where you are. Pacey's suggestions are a guide, not a target.
Emergencies
If you or someone else needs urgent help, call your local emergency number straight away. Pacey's Need help screen uses your phone's own calling, messaging and maps, so it only works when those do.
Safety features are free
Need help, emergency calling, sending your location and getting a ride home will always be free in Pacey.
Your data
Your nights and settings are stored on your phone. See the Privacy policy for what Pacey keeps and how to delete it.
Changes to these terms
We may update these terms. When we do, Pacey will ask you to read and agree to the new version.
No guarantees
Pacey is provided as it is. As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for decisions you make while using it, or for any harm from drinking.

privacy: The short version
Your nights stay on your phone. Your Pacey account only holds your email or sign-in and your plan from the quiz. There are no ads and no tracking, and we don't sell or share your data.
Your account

You create an account after the first-launch quiz, with Apple, Google or email. It keeps your sign-in details and your suggested plan, so you can restore them on a new phone. You can sign out or delete your account at any time in Settings › Profile.
What Pacey stores on your phone

Your plans, the drinks and water you log with their times, your morning check-ins, your drink types and sizes, your quick starts, reminder choices, and the name, trusted friend, weight and body type you add in Profile.
Weight and body type
These are optional. If you add them, they are used only on your phone to work out the blood alcohol estimate in your night summary. You can turn this off below.
Location
Pacey only looks up your location when you tap Send my location to a friend. It puts it in a message for you to send and doesn't store it.
Notifications
Reminders are scheduled on your phone. No one else sees them.
Contacts and messages
Pacey never reads your contacts or messages. When you send your location or call for help, your phone's own apps do it.
Your choices
You can change any detail in Settings, delete your saved nights below, or delete the app to remove everything.
Children
Pacey is not for anyone under the legal drinking age, and we don't knowingly collect anything about them.
Changes
If this policy changes, Pacey will show you the new version in the app.
